name: autoresearch
description: Ouroboros integration for Karpathy-style autoresearch experiment loops.

commands.name: inspect
commands.summary: Inspect an autoresearch checkout and report its Ouroboros handoff readiness.

arguments.name: repository_path
arguments.description: Path to a local autoresearch-compatible repository.

arguments.name: program_file
arguments.description: Repository-relative path to the autoresearch program brief (default: program.md).

arguments.name: target_file
arguments.description: Repository-relative path to the editable training target (default: train.py).

arguments.name: support_file
arguments.description: Repository-relative path to the fixed support/preparation file (default: prepare.py).

commands.name: prepare
commands.summary: Generate an Ouroboros Seed handoff for a bounded autoresearch loop.

arguments.name: repository_path
arguments.description: Path to a local autoresearch-compatible repository.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: Research objective to pass into ooo auto as the Seed goal.

arguments.name: program_file
arguments.description: Repository-relative path to the autoresearch program brief (default: program.md).

arguments.name: target_file
arguments.description: Repository-relative path to the editable training target (default: train.py).

arguments.name: support_file
arguments.description: Repository-relative path to the fixed support/preparation file (default: prepare.py).

arguments.name: metric
arguments.description: Primary comparison metric to optimize and report (default: val_bpb).

arguments.name: max_experiments
arguments.description: Maximum number of experiments to include in the handoff budget (default: 8).

arguments.name: train_command
arguments.description: Verification command agents should run for each experiment (default: uv run train.py).

capabilities.name: seed
capabilities.reason: Generate a concrete Seed handoff for ooo auto execution.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record research constraints, evaluation metric, and handoff output.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record upstream autoresearch repository assumptions and local checkout evidence.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Persist prepared handoff artifacts under the target repository.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Prepare generated Seed artifacts for an ooo auto handoff.

capabilities.name: progress
capabilities.reason: Report readiness and missing prerequisites before ooo auto starts.

permissions.reason: Inspect program.md, prepare.py, train.py, and repository layout.
Write the generated Seed and handoff manifest into .ouroboros/autoresearch/.
